- SKILL.md 는 18.3KB spine 으로 축소: frontmatter, Overview(+reference

  는 appendices.md, Example Flow 는 example-flow.md 로 이동

- description 을 1,405자 → 917자로 압축(런타임 절단 한계 1,024자 이내),
  트리거 키워드 12개는 전부 동일하게 보존
- docs/skills.md 의 codex-review-wrap 행을 새 frontmatter 트리거 절에서
  기계적으로 재유도(12개 키워드 전부 포함)
- writing-praxis-skill 가이드에 progressive-disclosure/references/ 절과
  description 1,024자 예산 규칙 추가; 서로 모순이던 두 예시를 수정
  (strikes 예시는 실제 파일과 일치시키고, cmux-recover-sessions 예시는
  명시적 schematic placeholder 로 교체)
- 이동한 본문을 검증하던 테스트 3건은 대상 경로만 갱신(단언 내용 불변):
  version-pins 는 step4-run-review.md 를 슬라이스, critic-probe 와
  finding-approval 은 spine+references 연결 버퍼를 대상으로 함

* docs(skills): one description budget, triggers inside the strict bound

RUNTIME_CONSTRAINTS.md §5 said 1,024 while CONTRIBUTING.md said 500, and
neither number is measured — §5 says so itself. codex-review-wrap's trigger
clause sat at character 687, which routes under one contract and is truncated
away under the other, so the skill's documented keywords were live or dead
depending on which file you believed.

Compress the description prose so the trigger clause starts at 483: a
description that clears the smaller bound routes correctly whichever bound is
real, and no live measurement is needed to make that true. CONTRIBUTING.md now
points at §5 instead of carrying a second number; §5 carries the operative
500-character trigger rule and says where 500 came from.

Confidence: high
Not-tested: the real runtime budget is still unmeasured — this makes the description safe under either candidate, it does not settle which one holds
Session-Id: c044205b-803f-48b1-acc9-aab9aa5e25e1

* test(skills): check reference reachability, not just content

The pinning assertions run against a buffer built by globbing
references/*.md, so a spine link that is deleted or misspelled leaves every
content assertion passing while a real reader can no longer reach the prose.
Content and reachability are different questions and the glob can only answer
the first.

Check the links directly: every reference file is linked from the spine, and
every link the spine makes resolves to a file that exists. Verified both ways
— removing the appendices link fails the check by name; the intact tree
passes.

Confidence: high
Not-tested: no runtime behaviour changed — test-only
Session-Id: c044205b-803f-48b1-acc9-aab9aa5e25e1
